description: This PHP source file defines the LoggerFactory class within the OrangeHRM framework. It includes methods for creating and retrieving logger instances, managing them via a static cache, and configuring log file paths and logging levels based on the application's debug mode.

classes.name: LoggerFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for providing logger instances, caching them to prevent duplication and configuring log handlers and levels based on application settings.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a logger instance identified by name, creating and configuring it if it doesn't already exist in the cache.
